aborted_attempts.error: Error: executor_v2 step 10: ToolCallFailed (HTTP 502): The app's API call failed: GET /accounts/{account_id}/r2/buckets failed before a response arrived. Recovery: Read the reported error and check the corresponding request or configuration. Retryable (unchanged call): no.
aborted_attempts.note: Slim publish board rep3 aborted mid-executor_v2 under the prior fail-fast harness. Session progress logged ok through 7000/10000; the next session threw ToolCallFailed (HTTP 502) on step 10 (r2-list-buckets) and exited the process — no board-rep3 artifact was written. That is an Executor under-load result, not only a harness glitch. Rep3 was restarted with continue-on-error so further 502s count toward error_rate.
